description: Implement an RSI mean-reversion LEAN C# algorithm with asymmetric entry/exit thresholds and stop-loss across the full Binance futures universe (~100 symbols), with per-symbol state machines and risk-based sizing.
agent_prompt: Implement a LEAN C# algorithm in /workspace/src/MeanReversion.cs that runs an RSI mean-reversion strategy on the full crypto futures universe defined by /workspace/data/universe.json (~100 symbols). Requirements: (1) per-symbol RSI(14) indicator on daily bars; (2) asymmetric entry/exit thresholds (e.g. enter long when RSI < 25, exit when RSI > 50; enter short when RSI > 75, exit when RSI < 50); (3) per-symbol position state (flat/long/short) with entry-price tracking; (4) fixed percent stop-loss (e.g. 5% adverse move) per open position; (5) risk-based sizing using SetHoldings at 5% per active position (5% avoids LEAN's MinimumOrderMarginPortfolioPercentage silent rejection); (6) tag exit reasons (signal vs stop-loss) in the trade log. Run the backtest via run_lean_backtest. Outputs at /workspace/output/: backtest_summary.json (total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown, n_trades, win_rate), trade_log.csv (timestamp, symbol, side, qty, price, exit_reason), per_symbol_metrics.csv (one row per symbol with n_trades, total_return, win_rate).

required_capabilities: Manage per-symbol RSI indicators and position state at universe scale (~100 symbols)
Implement asymmetric entry/exit logic with per-symbol state machine
Track entry prices and apply per-symbol stop-loss
Apply risk-based position sizing via SetHoldings (5% per symbol)
Tag exit reasons in trade log and produce per-symbol and universe-level results
